status: concrete Stage 1 source contract; implementation not yet added
scope: Project ordinary Struct fields through ArrayMap-owned List/LargeList paths inside a row capture; preserve atomic logical leaf representations.

demand_domains.whole: Retain the entire subtree when observed as a value or consumed by an unsupported operation. Union dominates all weaker demand.
demand_domains.shape: ArrayMap and ArrayLength require outer list validity, offsets and length even when body is constant and no element field is requested.
demand_domains.parent_validity: GetField must propagate null ancestors; an empty selected Struct still retains its logical validity and exact length.
demand_domains.element_validity: A selected element Struct retains its validity even with zero fields; is_defined(element) and null input element lambda semantics must match original.
demand_domains.field_validity: is_defined(element.field) requires that field’s logical parent/own validity, not merely its siblings. Primitive/atomic leaf buffers remain unchanged in this stage.
demand_domains.payload: Only demanded ordinary Struct children are borrowed; selected atomic leaf descriptors must already match and are never silently cast.

analysis: Extend the existing trie with an element edge distinct from named Struct edges and an explicit shape/validity-only use, retaining whole-use dominance. No cloned root-to-leaf path vectors.

ArrayMap over a resolvable captured array path binds its element parameter to the element edge in a distinct lexical context; traverse body demand there rather than marking the whole input value. Nested arrays/maps repeat the same transfer.

Memoize original expression identity together with lexical binding context and exact capture identity/type. Shared callback bodies under different bindings cannot share an unqualified demand memo. Whole and leaf consumers union into the same source binding.

ArrayLength and IsMissing may use shape/validity-only demand where semantics are known; unfamiliar collection operators or dynamic whole-value consumers mark the affected subtree whole, not an unrelated capture.

Original body typing validates declared lambda types. Projected callback schemas and corresponding typed variable descriptors must be rebuilt consistently in the same lexical scope before lowering; no name-only global rewrite.
prepared_view: Compile a typed recursive Struct/List/LargeList view once per query from the selected physical type.

At batch binding borrow original child ArrayRefs, offsets and null buffers; preserve full physical child length and sliced offset ownership, including hidden null ranges. Use safe Arrow constructors and count their mask-validation cost.
Empty selected Structs use explicit original length and original null mask. Never replace an omitted payload with a different observable validity or fabricate contiguous offsets.

Selected logical Call/Set/Dict/Locus/array leaves are atomic with exact physical compatibility; unused surrounding siblings do not block pruning. Any needed conversion retains the whole affected capture until separately supported.
Retained backing owners are not claimed released. Original source/spill retention charges and producer computations/effects remain unchanged.
public_oracles: Constant map over nullable List<Struct> with no selected fields; length and is_defined array/element controls, null elements versus missing outer array, empty lists.
Nested Array<Struct<Array<Struct>>> selecting one primitive/list field, selected-null field and null ancestor; complete nested Option outputs with unused defined and hidden payload growth.
Shared whole-plus-leaf demand, two distinct leaf callbacks, lexical shadowing and reused callback DAGs under different parameters, explicit typed lambda descriptors.
Selected logical leaf values/types plus unused logical sibling at every ordinary Struct level.
Allocation counterfactual with fixture construction/query preparation outside counting; unchanged baseline must reproduce growth, candidate must not. Full/whole paths remain semantic controls.
claims_excluded: No source IO pruning or requested-byte claim from this capture-only stage
No recursive null compaction, owner-release, throughput or SIMD claim
No benchmark VM use or changes to frozen comparison artifacts
